name: rust-node-monorepo
description: Monorepo with a Rust/Axum backend and a Node frontend workspace, sharing one PostgreSQL database.

rules.message: Backend lives at src/ (Cargo workspace root), frontend at apps/web, shared libraries at packages/.
SQLite does not fit a multi-process monorepo backend. Use PostgreSQL.
The backend authenticates via KanIDM but the frontend does not. Add subscription-center-sveltekit, or the admin UI has no way to start a session.
The Axum backend talks to PostgreSQL but no migration workflow is selected. Add sqlx-migrate.
